evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search method (content identification/fingerprinting) not substantially contained in any other story.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: Search-by-profile is a distinct requirement compared to other discovery methods.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative/user-similarity based discovery differs materially from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Specific goal (find music/ringback tones similar to a given music video) is distinct from other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Search-by-enriched-metadata/image-tags is a distinct technique/scope from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
evaluations.rationale: Upload-and-propagate-tags is a distinct ingestion/metadata requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments.
evaluations.rationale: UI need (view thumbnail sequences) is unique and not repeated in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates ZO-009 which requests info about 'perceptually similar' items—no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in / duplicates ZO-008 (both request info about similar items/segments; 'perceptually' is a narrower subtype, not a meaningful actor/context/goal change).

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles.
evaluations.rationale: Distinct recommendation source (similar profiles) not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area.
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation based on local news/events is a distinct trigger and goal.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Person identification and related-info requirement is specific and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify products in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a different object type than other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is a specific detection need distinct from other items.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification differs in target from other identification stories; thematic similarity alone doesn't imply duplication.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image.
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation is a distinct interaction and goal.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest.
evaluations.rationale: Geo-map discovery requirement is unique in scope and context.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search content items using automatic speech recognition.
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a unique search modality not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is a specific administrative task not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment.
evaluations.rationale: News-segment annotation and topic extraction is a distinct admin function.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects.
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload.
evaluations.rationale: Edited-audio detection is a specific validation need not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter nudity content.
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a specific content-moderation requirement distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information.
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering based on low-level asset info is distinguished from high-level tag/metadata prefiltering (ZO-026).

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement.
evaluations.rationale: Automatic copyright validation is a unique legal/validation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering based on high-level metadata/tags differs materially from low-level asset prefiltering (ZO-024).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk.
evaluations.rationale: Assessment of picture 'interestingness' using combined signals is a specific analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments.
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists based on annotations/Talk is a distinct detection trigger and goal.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify volunteer types.
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer type identification is a unique classification requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features.
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is project-specific and distinct from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific detection (Snapshot Serengeti) differs from other project-specific requirements.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images.
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection for timestamping malfunction is a unique technical requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Snapshot Serengeti is project- and goal-specific and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., age/sex/etc.) differs from species/number detection; not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Animal count detection is a distinct analytic goal from other Snapshot Serengeti tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal.
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is a project-specific vision task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific 'no classifiable plankton' detection differs from Snapshot Serengeti equivalent (ZO-031).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a specific analytic requirement distinct from other plankton stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is a specific classification task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab.
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis for video reduction is project- and purpose-specific and unique.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg.
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a distinct requirement from general motion analysis (ZO-040).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images.
evaluations.rationale: Satellite imagery feature detection is a unique task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience.
evaluations.rationale: Assessing classification weight by experience is a specific analytics requirement distinct from other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors.
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is a specific prefiltering goal not duplicated by other image prefilter stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect moving and transient objects in the images.
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct vision requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files.
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a specific processing need distinct from filtering/ranking tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group whale calls that are similar.
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call grouping is a domain-specific clustering task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file.
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a distinct detection/estimation task separate from grouping (ZO-047).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should interrupt a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Decision to interrupt is a distinct control/timing requirement not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Modality-choice for interruption is a specific aspect tied to interruption (ZO-049) but not a duplicate since it addresses modality.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should educate a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: 'When to educate' differs in goal (education) from 'when to interrupt' or other moderation actions.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Modality-choice for education is distinct from modality-choice for interruption (ZO-050) and addresses a different goal.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin,I want to know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the specific educational content is a distinct decision from timing or modality questions.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is a unique signal-detection requirement not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates ZO-056 ('when Zoonibot should give an explanation') — timing of Zoonibot comments and timing of explanations are not meaningfully different actors/contexts/goals.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should give an explanation.
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in / duplicates ZO-055 (both concern when Zoonibot should interject; 'explanation' is a type of comment rather than a meaningful change in goal/context).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Specifying content of Zoonibot messages is a different requirement (message content) than timing of comments/explanations (ZO-055/056).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group subjects by similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Grouping subjects by similarity is a distinct clustering requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences.
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation for volunteers is a distinct recommendation goal separate from content recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them.
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a unique content-processing requirement not duplicated elsewhere.
